title: Event-Time Order-Flow Memory, Operational-Time Impact, and Subordinated Market Observables
abstract: arXiv:2609.13715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider two canonical market-microstructure regularities: the long-memory of trade signs and the square-root law of meta-order impact. The point is not to propose new empirical laws, but to separate the clocks on which existing laws are defined. The sign-memory law is an event-time statement about the ordering and fragmentation of hidden orders. The square-root impact law is an operational-time statement about front motion in a locally linear latent order book. Starting from a discrete-time random-walk bid/ask reaction--diffusion order book with a separate event clock, we identify an event-time imbalance reduction, derive the operational-time front and impact equations in the locally linear regime, and then subordinate both sign and impact observables to calendar time. translated_title: 事件时间下的订单流记忆、操作时间下的冲击与从属化后的市场观测量
translated_abstract: 我们考虑市场微观结构中的两个经典规律：交易符号的长记忆性以及母订单（meta-order）冲击的平方根定律。本文的重点并非提出新的经验规律，而是区分这些既有规律所依赖的不同时钟。符号记忆规律是关于隐藏订单的排序与碎片化的事件时间陈述；平方根冲击规律则是关于局部线性潜在订单簿中前沿运动的操作时间陈述。从具有独立事件时钟的离散时间随机游走买卖反应-扩散订单簿模型出发，我们识别出一个事件时间下的不平衡削减机制，在局部线性区间推导出操作时间下的前沿运动方程与冲击方程，随后将符号与冲击这两类观测量均从属化（投影）至日历时间。分数型或截断型的时钟效应正是通过这一“事件时间到日历时间”的投影进入观测结果，而非源于一种不同的操作时间冲击机制。这给出了一个紧凑的…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文的核心贡献在于从带有独立事件时钟的随机游走反应-扩散订单簿模型出发，分离了交易符号长记忆规律（事件时间）与平方根冲击规律（操作时间）所依赖的不同时钟，并证明分数/截断时钟效应仅通过事件到日历时间的从属化投影进入市场观测量，而非通过不同的冲击机制。
en_tdlr: The key contribution is separating the clocks behind two canonical market-microstructure laws—trade-sign long memory in event time and square-root impact in operational time—via a discrete random-walk reaction-diffusion order book with a separate event clock, showing that fractional or tempered clock effects enter market observables only through the event-to-calendar subordination projection.
